name: Freakazoid!
description: The adventures of  Freakazoid, a manic, insane superhero who battles with an array of super villains.

videos.title: Freakazoid: The Original Freak
videos.overview: How what started as a straightforward animated action hero evolved into a chaotically comic cartoon phenom

videos.title: Freakazoid-less Freakazoid Promos
videos.overview: Cruise ship parodies that promoted the series launch

videos.title: Liebeslied für Normadeus
videos.overview: Series creators and crew recall the show's second year and the making of the epic, cameo-crammed final episode

videos.title: A Full Season's Worth of Commentaries (in Five Minutes or Less)
videos.overview: Favorite moments remembered

videos.title: Alternate Episode: The Cloud / Candle Jack
videos.overview: In addition to the 24 main episodes of Freakazoid!, several variant episodes aired, re-configuring the cartoon segments into new combinations and sometimes adding new content, post-credit tags or gag credits. This variant episode (also included on the Season 1 DVD), transplants "The Cloud" from s01e10, and "Candle Jack" from s01e02.

videos.title: Teen Titans Go! s06e33: Huggbees
videos.overview: The Brain teams up with The Lobe, so the Titans enlist the help of Freakazoid to stop them.

videos.title: Five Day Forecast / Dance of Doom / Hand Man
videos.overview: Freakazoid does the weather, rescues a hostage high-school dance and loses a sidekick to marriage.

videos.title: Candle Jack / Toby Danger in Doomsday Bet / The Lobe
videos.overview: Freakazoid rescues campers from a monster and narrowly escapes a lobotomy. Toby Danger must stop Dr. Sin.

videos.title: Mo-Ron / The Sewer Rescue / The Big Question / The Legends Who Lunch
videos.overview: A forgetful alien tries to recall his message for mankind, Lord Bravery's first act as a superhero hopeful turns out to be a problem, aliens circles the Earth in hopes of finding an answer to the eternal question of the universe and elderly superheroes dine and recall their glory days.

videos.title: And Fan Boy Is His Name / Lawn Gnomes Chapter IV: Fun in the Sun / Freak's French Lesson
videos.overview: In the first segment (And Fanboy is his Name), an pudgy teenager calling himself Fanboy tries to become Freakazoid's sidekick. The second segment deals with the story of 4 gnomes, who after causing mischief for vikings many years in the past, are turned to stone by day, but come to life at night to help mankind. The final segment (Frenching with Freakazoid) has our hero teaching French to the audience.

videos.title: Foamy the Freakadog / Office Visit / Ode to Leonard Nimoy / Emergency Broadcast System / Cönversational Nörwegian
videos.overview: A rabid dog-like creature becomes Freak's new sidekick; Lord Bravery fights bureaucracy over his name; Fan Boy rhapsodizes over his quest for Spock's autograph; Freak teaches Norwegian.

videos.title: The Chip: Part 1
videos.overview: Jack Valenti hosts the story of how Freakazoid got his powers and the promise of seeing a grown man wrestle a bear.

videos.title: The Chip: Part 2 / Freakazoid is History
videos.overview: The conclusion to the story of Freak's origins. A vortex sucks Freak into the past.

videos.title: Hot Rods from Heck / A Time for Evil
videos.overview: Freak foils a plot to use robotic cars to steal nuclear weapons. The Huntsman goes in search of crime.

videos.title: Relax-O-Vision / Fatman and Boy Blubber / Limbo Lock-Up / Terror Palace
videos.overview: In order to provide a more calming effect to today's rather violent cartoons, the network censors initiate 'Relax-o-Vision.' The process projects peaceful scenes of tranquility over more violent parts of the day's cartoon. Freakzoid tolerates the interference with his show, until he finally decides to take matters into his own hands against the censors.

videos.title: In Arm's Way / The Cloud
videos.overview: Freak goes Christmas shopping and searches for the answer to a mysterious cloud which seems to be turning people into zombies.

videos.title: Next Time, Phone Ahead / Nerdator
videos.overview: The cartoon is cut short when the show's lazy writers decide to end the episode early to show more 'Animaniacs' reruns. However, Steven Spielberg won't stand for it, and unleashes his vision to finish the cartoon right. Dexter Douglas soon meets a strange alien named Mo-Ron, who becomes lost from his alien friends. Dexter helps Mo-Ron phone home, and soon all is well-that is, until the long distance charges roll in.

videos.title: House of Freakazoid / Sewer or Later
videos.overview: Freak must rescue a werewolf from his cursed state, and delve into the sewers after a pack of jewel thieves led by the Cobra Queen.

videos.title: The Wrath of Guitierrez
videos.overview: This episode involves Armondo Guitierrez, whose company created the Pinnacle microchip that turned Dexter Douglas into Freakazoid (gasp!). After using an internet connection and special series of keystrokes, Guttierrez escapes into cyberspace, and begins to mess things up for Freakazoid. After traveling into cyberspace, Freakazoid meets a new and improved Armondo. After a wrist-timer is wired to his wrist, Freakazoid has one hour to go through the game 'Amazing Castle's to find the key to unlock it, otherwise he will be deleted.

videos.title: Dexter's Date
videos.overview: The Lobe's plot to cripple the television industry interrupts Steff and Dexter's first date.

videos.title: The Freakazoid
videos.overview: Freak can't refuse anyone anything on his birthday, according to the Superhero Code Book. Even if the request comes from a villain who wants to be free from heroic interference in his nefarious scheme.

videos.title: Mission: Freakazoid
videos.overview: Freak and his friends travel to a police state to rescue another friend.

videos.title: Virtual Freak
videos.overview: Freak and Cosgrove are zapped inside a Virtual Tussle virtual reality game.

videos.title: Hero Boy
videos.overview: Guitierrez returns with a device that could vaporize the entire world.

videos.title: A Matter of Love
videos.overview: Cosgrove's girlfriend takes up all his time and is a fire-breathing monster.

videos.title: Statuesque
videos.overview: Freak pursues the madman who turned Steff into a statue.

videos.title: Island of Dr. Mystico
videos.overview: An evil scientist crashes Freak's plane, trying to add to his human stock for his experiments in crossbreeding with orangutans.

videos.title: Two Against Freak
videos.overview: Freak's attempts to learn telekinesis leaves him too tired to adequately guard the Diamond Hat of the Czars.

videos.title: Freak-a-Panel / Tomb of Invisibo
videos.overview:
Freak-a-Panel: While on the trail of Cave Guy, Freakazoid finds himself at a sci-fi convention and despite the fact that everyone is in costume, he needs to find the real Cave Guy and get out.

Tomb of Invisibo: An invisible villain from ancient Egypt has been released, and is causing havoc throughout the world.

videos.title: Normadeus
videos.overview: The Lobe kidnaps PBS's famed carpenter, Norm Abram, to build a wooden device that would kill Freak.
